nodes.label: Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) + fluorescent probes for local pH assessment in alkaline media on model/unsupported electrodes
nodes.description:
Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) + fluorescent probes for local pH assessment in alkaline media on model/unsupported electrodes
Owner organization: ICPEES@CNRS/Unistra
Task: T1.2
Maturity: under development
Documentation: DOI: 10.1039/d3cp00938f (see Figure 2b)
Range of validity or processability: 
In pH, a 0.05 variation should be visible with a ratiometric probe; Spatial resolution is bound to the light and correction factors, i.e., 200 nm (in all directions). The current pH range is ca. 7 - 12.
internal key: Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) + fluorescent probes for local pH assessment in alkaline media on model/unsupported electrodes0

nodes.description:

Owner organization: ICPEES@CNRS/Unistra
Task: T1.2
Maturity: under development
Documentation: DOI: 10.1039/d3cp00938f (see Figure 2b)
Range of validity or processability: 
In pH, a 0.05 variation should be visible with a ratiometric probe; Spatial resolution is bound to the light and correction factors, i.e., 200 nm. A probe with a ratiometric signal in the 1 - 5 pH range shall be used 5 (with the Lysosensor Green DND 181)
